RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is weak evidence on its own — it's the norm in structural engineering and reflects the existing pipeline more than any panel's intent. Treated as your headline, it looks speculative and invites dismissal.

Your stronger facts are the credentials gap (15 years, master's, three major projects led versus eight years) and the unanswered request for written reasons. "Excellent client relationships" is a legitimate criterion for a group head, but it's vague and easily reverse-engineered after the fact — press for how it was scored.

So: chase the written explanation in writing, with a deadline. Keep panel composition in reserve as supporting context if the reasons turn out to be thin or inconsistent.
